Messages.Author: X_Zealot
Messages.Body:
If I have an opponent who burns a leather jacket to prevent damage from a
strike, then later I grasp the ghostly that leather jacket and burn it to
prevent damage from a strike.
In whose ashheap does the leather jacket remain?

Comments Welcome,
Norman S. Brown, Jr.
XZealot
Archon of the Swamp

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"X_Zealot" <x_ze...@bellsouth.net> wrote in message
news:%OGt7.29164$2H2.2...@e3500-atl1.usenetserver.com...

> If I have an opponent who burns a leather jacket to prevent damage from a
> strike, then later I grasp the ghostly that leather jacket and burn it to
> prevent damage from a strike.
> In whose ashheap does the leather jacket remain?

The Leather Jacket will return to its original owners ash heap.

The same way it would if you had stolen it with a strike,
equipped it off a Temptation victim, raved it off a Mind Raped vampire,
or traded it with a Succubus Club.

When cards leave play (or enter the ashheap in any fashion)
they always immediately return to the card's owner's ashheap.

See the definition of Ash Heap in the Rules Glossary:

http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/rulebook/rulebook.html#rules_glossary

"Ash Heap: The discard pile. Cards that are burned are returned
to their owner's ash heap."

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

Messages.Author: Madman2001
Messages.Body:
Mr. Lasombra, sir:

Does using Grasp the Ghostly to "Move equipment from any other
Methuselah's ash heap to this minion" count as "equipping"? For
example, would a Leather Jacket obtained in this manner untap the
active minion at the end of the turn?

Madman the curious

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Since Lasombra answers my questions, I'll answer his:

No.

"Move from here to there" is not "equipping".

"Equipping" must use the verb "equip" (as in the cardless action
to move equipment or Magic of the Smith.
